Using Interest for availing banking services 6539 views Q. My company provides medical benefit for a couple and two children.Comapany pays insurance premium for all of them.Currently company is providing medical benefit of Rs 5000/- for normal medical treatment and Rs 45,000/- for Hospitalization. Please let me know whether I can avail this benefit? Also company is proving higher medical benefit of Rs 5 lakh for hospitalization but we need to pay premium to avail this benefit. Please let me know whether I can avail this benefit? 3009 views Q. A philantrophist had bequeathed aproperty for the purpose of a Jamath Khana (Apparently as Sawab e Jaria).The present committee is planning to construct a shopping complex space for a Jamath khana is to be suitably provided.The money derived from this would be used for the benefit of the community.Since funds are not available the committee is planning to take a loan on interest. Taking or giving of interes is haram in Islam. Will this not amount to feeding the community with haram money ? Pl clarify. 1435 views Q. i am clerk in government service if i put my savings as fixed deposit in bank, the intrest on fixed deposit is lawful, inshaallah give me reply. 2166 views Q. Many companies who had been traditionally providing health care to their employees directly have now been shifting to medical insurance companies, whereby a lump sum amount is given to insurer annually regardless of actual medical expense, and in return, employee avail the medical facility through insurance company. Is it permissible for employee to avail medical facility through this arrangemet. Please note that the empployee has nothing to do with this arrangement. 2524 views Q. Please help us to find the right way in our life. I am a software engineer working for a software company. The focus of our software company is banking field and most of the clients are banks. The problem I am facing now is that the project that I am working is for banking software and the bank that I am working is not Islamic bank. The software that I develop or involved is used by the Bank to open account on-line through internet,applying on-line application for credit card, to view the Interest rates on internet for checking account, saving account and fixed deposits, etc.. I ask you to guide me whether doing work for a bank is haram (unlawful) even though I am not directly working for the bank and salary is given by my company, not the Bank. 2274 views Q. About home loan 2158 views Q. Claim of Health Insurance 9459 views Q. Can interest money be used as accident compensation? 1841 views Q. Use of bank interest 3376 views Q. I want to take fatwa on the issue related to my sister married in Pakistan. Her husband died few months ago and he was working in a bank in Karachi. Now after his death the bank had given certain amount of money to my sister by saying that it is group Insurance money. But my brother in law never ever gave any amount no matter monthly, quarterly or yearly in the form of premium to the bank for this group insurance. The bank officials told that it is compulsory for all the employees working in that bank to take group insurance (which is provided free of cost by the bank to its employees) and the yearly premiums for that group insurance was being given by the bank and not by the employee. I will be highly grateful and thankful to you if can tell me (give fatwa) in the light of Islamic principles that the money is JAIEZ or HARAAM. Warm Regards? 3104 views Q. Some people use their interest money of banks to pay off bribes to policemen (for traffic fines etc) Is this permissible according to the Shariah? 4693 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 48144 Country: India Title: Interest of masjid funds. Question: My question is regarding the interest amount of funds of masjid kept in any bank. For which work this interest amount can be used. Can toilet for masjid be constructed using interest amount of the mosque’s fund kept in the bank? Answer ID: 48144 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1296/1296/M=11/1434) The interest money should be withdrawn from the bank and given to the poor and needy ones without the intention of reward. This money should not be used for the construction of mosque toilets. لأن سبيل الكسب الخبيث التصدق الخ (شامى) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
